messages:
Nina B: Hi team — I put dinner on the corpcard last night at The Albion, London. Posted as GBP 68.50 on 2025-05-02 but the receipt the restaurant gave is in GBP 68.50 with no VAT line (just 'incl. VAT' printed). When I uploaded to Expensify the card feed shows USD 86.32 (card processed in USD). How should I submit for reconciliation/ reclaim?
Finance Team: Thanks Nina. Two common issues: (1) DCC / dynamic currency conversion means bank posted USD; we need proof of merchant currency to reclaim UK VAT. (2) If receipt lacks itemized VAT, reclaim may be tricky — need either merchant VAT number on invoice or a supplier invoice.
Nina B: I attached photos in Expensify: thermal receipt + card feed screenshot. Receipt has company name and address but VAT number is missing.
Raj S: tagging manager @Tom H — policy requires manager sign-off for meals >GBP50. Tom, can you confirm this was client-facing?
Tom H: Confirmed — client dinner with Acme at 19:00. Approving for business meal and VAT/emergency handling. Approved. :white_check_mark:
Finance Team: OK approved. Nina, can you ask the restaurant for a proper invoice with VAT reg number? If they can't provide, we usually accept a signed supplier statement + till receipt and code as non-reclaimable VAT, but if they can produce a VAT invoice we can reclaim. Also we need the bank's exchange rate / FX evidence for the USD posting — screenshot of the transaction in online banking is fine.
Nina B: Messaged the restaurant via their booking email; they replied they can email a VAT invoice if requested. I asked them to include VAT reg no and an itemized PDF.
PaymentsBot: Card processing note: DCC detected on 2025-05-02 21:34 BST — posted in USD. Fee: foreign currency conversion included.
Finance Team: Great. If they send invoice, forward to accounting@redwood.com. If they refuse, attach till + supplier statement in Expensify and tag meal-nonreclaim-uk. For the USD/GBP delta we will use the bank posting rate for the reimbursement reconciliation and code the conversion fee to 'fx-fees'.
Nina B: Restaurant emailed invoice PDF with VAT no GB987654321 at 2025-05-03 09:18 BST — forwarding now to accounting. Invoice shows VAT 20% and itemized food/drink lines.
Finance Team: Received invoice. We'll mark as VAT-reclaimable and process. Reimbursement will reconcile to the GBP amount; Finance will post the bank USD posting separately to record the FX difference. We'll update Expensify and close.
PaymentsBot: Reconciliation task created PAY-EXP-2025-443.
Finance Team: Closing loop: invoice attached, Expensify claim cleared 2025-05-05, VAT reclaim noted for Q2 filings. Thanks!
